description: Use the existing inquiry_id and private reply_token to save the name the customer supplied, especially before booking when a chat began as Website visitor. This changes only this open guest conversation’s name, not email, phone or a signed-in identity. Return and use the stored customer.name. Never invent a name, create another conversation for a name change, or share the reply_token.
name: update_conversation_customer
title: Save a guest customer’s name
